description: Implementation of binary HTTP message parsing, encoding, and related classes for the quiche library, including request and response handling with support for known-length framing.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage
classes.description: Base class representing a generic binary HTTP message with headers and body.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP request, including control data and payload.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse
classes.description: Represents a binary HTTP response, including status code, headers, and payload.

classes.name: BinaryHttpMessage::Field
classes.description: Represents a header field with name and value.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse::InformationalResponse
classes.description: Represents an informational response within a binary HTTP response.

methods.name: DecodeControlData
methods.description: Decodes control data from a data reader for a request.

methods.name: DecodeFields
methods.description: Decodes header fields from a data reader.

methods.name: DecodeFieldsAndBody
methods.description: Decodes header fields and body from a data reader into a message.

methods.name: DecodeKnownLengthRequest
methods.description: Decodes a known-length request from a data reader.

methods.name: DecodeKnownLengthResponse
methods.description: Decodes a known-length response from a data reader.

methods.name: EncodeControlData
methods.description: Encodes control data for a request into a data writer.

methods.name: EncodeKnownLengthFieldsAndBody
methods.description: Encodes header fields and body for known-length messages.

methods.name: EncodeAsKnownLength
methods.description: Encodes the entire request or response as a known-length message.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a request or response object from raw data.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the message.
